description.intro: The Puma Liga F 26 27 Cup T.5 Stellar ball is designed to offer excellent performance in training and amateur matches. Inspired by the official ball of the Women's League, it combines resistance, good touch and great durability to withstand sessions of frequent use. Its abrasion-resistant construction ensures reliable and consistent performance every play.
key_benefits: Official Liga F design: Inspired by the ball of the Spanish women's competition.
Alta resistencia: Materiales preparados para entrenamientos regulares.
Stable flight: Optimized construction to improve precision.
Gran durabilidad: Excelente rendimiento en uso frecuente.
